added: Place: a glass-roofed railway platform at night, with an idle cream-coloured train on the far track and warm lamplight across the wooden bench.
Activity: she pauses between trains to sip tea from a ceramic travel cup.

Posture and composition: seated upright on the end of the bench, knees angled together, photographed from eye height in a three-quarter knee-up portrait. Her right hand holds the travel cup just below her chin; her left hand rests open on the bench beside her hip, wrist and forearm visible.
